channel.title: Agora Updates
channel.description: Updates for Agora, your local personal CRM.

item.title: Agora 1.2.1
item.description:
# Agora 1.2.1
- Fix the Outlook task pane showing “Not found” when Office appends parameters to the page URL. Serve the same bundled page and assets while preserving authentication and the strict file allowlist. - Exercise Office-style task pane URLs and authenticated email capture with an isolated packaged app before publishing each release.
This release is Developer ID signed. Apple notarisation is unavailable because the saved local Keychain profile is missing; this release has no notarisation ticket.
# Agora 1.2.0
- Delete a person and their history from People → More, with a confirmation showing interaction and commitment counts and an automatic private database backup. - Merge duplicate people into a chosen profile. Keep all conversations, commitments and source links; retain alternate email addresses, combine tags and notes, and preserve conflicting profile details in notes. - Search for merged people by their alternate addresses. Future email capture recognises those addresses and remains idempotent when duplicate message copies are merged. - Group the timeline by date or person, and show the elapsed time since each person's previous interaction. Gaps use the complete history even when filters hide earlier interactions. - Show full interaction dates and times in the timeline. Remember the chosen grouping.
The app and disk image are Developer ID signed, notarised by Apple and include stapled tickets.
# Agora 1.1.1
- Show a green checkmark and Configured badge for each AI client when its saved settings match the installed Agora helper and current library. - Show clear warnings for missing, disabled, outdated or unreadable configuration, with a reason and a setup action. - Refresh configuration status after setup, when Agora becomes active, or with Check configuration. - Reject misleading configured states when the helper is missing or arguments, transport or library settings are incorrect.
The app and disk image are Developer ID signed, notarised by Apple and include stapled tickets.
# Agora 1.1.0
- Set up local MCP connections for Codex / ChatGPT, Claude Desktop and Claude Code directly in Connections, with configuration backups and status reporting. - Keep custom libraries connected to the correct MCP server, and prevent registration from temporary builds or mounted disk images. - Add automatic update preferences for background checks and automatic download / installation. - Describe editable MCP fields, nullable deadlines and tool safety hints in discovery; report the bundled app version during the MCP handshake. - Expand MCP verification to cover all ten tools, error recovery, pagination, atomic capture and stale writes. - Independently verify update signatures against the public key shipped in the app, and require Developer ID signing for publication. - Normalize imported contact profiles before enforcing email uniqueness; reject invalid tags and revision overflow, and allow pairing-key rotation before first use. - Prevent demo mode from adding sample data when the data directory is empty or points to the default private library.
This release is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple. The app and disk image include stapled notarisation tickets.
Outlook capture passes the local authenticated HTTPS test. Installation and capture in a signed-in Outlook mailbox still need account-level verification.
# Agora 1.0.0
The first release of Agora, a native personal CRM for macOS 14 and later on Apple silicon.
- People profiles with contact details, tags and notes. - Commitments with deadlines, priorities, source conversations and kept / cancelled states. - Separate tracking for promises you made and promises made to you. - A focused overview and searchable conversation timeline. - Outlook for Mac task-pane add-in with explicit email capture and atomic commitment registration. - Standalone local MCP server with ten tools, sharing the same SQLite library. - Portable JSON export and import, and consistent SQLite backups. - Sparkle updates from GitHub Releases, built and published directly from a Mac without GitHub Actions.
Outlook add-in installation requires a supported mailbox and manual sideloading through your Microsoft account. Real mailbox capture has not yet been verified in a signed-in Outlook session.
